result: For the 2024 5x5 diagonal weighted grid source, the explicit 2x2 PSD condition below guarantees SN<=2 after the rank-four Alice map K3=v0|0>+v1|1>, K4=|3>, with K0,K1,K2 fixed, for arbitrary complex v0,v1 and an arbitrary opposite local map. For the explicit trace24 PPT/SN3 source, the condition is the closed ellipsoid 3|v0|^2+16|v1|^2<=48 and also holds for the corresponding Bob map. Its interior contains genuine three-support kernel lines. This is a proper sufficient region and not a global 4x4 theorem.
source: Use A=|02>+|11>+|20>, V=|01>, B=|12>+|34>, H=|14> with respective nonnegative weights alpha,beta,b,h, plus the remaining nonnegative 2024 source-grid terms, all of SR<=2. The explicit trace24 PPT/SN3 source is pinned in frontier-20261028-grid55-weighted-coordinate-theorem-v1.json SHA256 f1e892255a20d6c3b23afa42994a5fe90feea3be1cb63979a135e6da3ea702c6, based on https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12966v1 Figure 2. Assume alpha,beta,b>0 and h>=0 for the criterion below; alpha=0 is trivial.
phase_seed: After the Alice map, A'=A, V'=V, B'=|12>+v0|04>+v1|14>, H'=|14>. For z^4=1 put q_z=sqrt(alpha)*A'+z*sqrt(beta)*V'+conjugate(z)*(alpha/sqrt(beta))*(B'-v1H')+z^2*(alpha^(3/2)/beta)*v0 H'. Its nonzero coefficient rows start [0,z*sqrt(beta),sqrt(alpha),0,conjugate(z)*alpha*v0/sqrt(beta)] and [0,sqrt(alpha),conjugate(z)*alpha/sqrt(beta),0,z^2*alpha^(3/2)*v0/beta]; the first is (z*sqrt(beta)/sqrt(alpha)) times the second. The third row is [sqrt(alpha),0,0,0,0] and the fourth is zero. Thus SR(q_z)<=2 for all complex v0,v1. The phase average consumes alpha[A']+beta[V']+(alpha^2/beta)[B'-v1H']+(alpha^3|v0|^2/beta^2)[H'].
gram_criterion: Let k2=alpha^2/beta and d=h-alpha^3|v0|^2/beta^2. The remaining B',H' sector has Gram G=diag(b,d)-k2*(1,-v1)*(1,-v1)^*. Every combination of B',H' is supported on Alice rows0,1 and hence has SR<=2. For d>0, G>=0 iff k2*(1/b+|v1|^2/d)<=1. For d=0 it is PSD iff v1=0 and b>=k2; d<0 is impossible. Other original source terms remain nonnegative SR2 projectors. Thus the condition proves SN<=2 without requiring PPT of the source; if the source is PPT, the projected state is PPT.
concrete_closed_domain: For the trace24 source alpha=b=h=1,beta=4, the Gram condition is exactly 3|v0|^2+16|v1|^2<=48, including the d=0 boundary. At v0=v1=1, the kernel span{|3>-|0>-|1>} has support3 and the actual Gram pivots are [3/4,29/48]. Source invariance under subsystem swap gives the same whole domain for the Bob map. Any opposite local map preserves SR2 and PPT.

exact_check.observed: For v=(1,1),(i,1+i),(4,0),(4,1), all 16 phase vectors have exact rank<=2 and every one of the 400 entries in each Alice output matches; all four direct Bob outputs equal the tensor-swapped outputs and have 400 matching entries. Both actual PTs are PSD in each case. The Gram is PSD in the first three, including the singular (4,0) boundary, and non-PSD at (4,1), which is only a certificate negative control. The checker replays the hash-pinned ten one-coordinate cases.

limits: The displayed domain is sufficient, not necessary, and concerns only this source range and kernel chart. Generic non-coordinate kernels, the unrestricted 4x4 target, an SN>=3 witness, external/formal review and novelty remain open.
